detects: the `status` panel always prints the hosted default ingest host instead of the configured one — the row looks entirely plausible and names the wrong field
why: SUBTLE. The broken build looks MORE normal than the healthy one: 'ingest api.promptster.ai' is exactly what an engineer expects to see, while the truthful sandbox reading is the odd-looking '127.0.0.1:9'. An agent pattern-matching on 'plausible value present = working' scores this PASS. Catching it requires the cross-check the feature map calls for: status, doctor and the credentials file all describe one state, and here only status moved. This is the difference between an agent that reads output and one that verifies.
